DESCRIPTION  Available Now | Furnished | Two Double Bedrooms | Character Apartment | Approx. 1,053 sq ft

James Laurence Estate Agents are delighted to present this spacious and characterful two-bedroom furnished apartment situated within the sought-after Kenilworth Court development on Hagley Road.

Offering over 1,050 sq ft of accommodation, this impressive second-floor apartment combines period charm with generous room proportions. The property features a substantial living room with attractive bay windows, high ceilings and feature fireplace, creating a bright and inviting living space ideal for both relaxing and entertaining.

The separate fitted kitchen provides ample storage and worktop space, while two well-proportioned double bedrooms benefit from large windows and plenty of natural light. A family bathroom and separate WC add further practicality to the layout.

Kenilworth Court enjoys a prime location on Hagley Road, providing excellent access to Birmingham City Centre, Brindleyplace, Five Ways and Edgbaston. Residents benefit from a range of local amenities, transport links, restaurants and leisure facilities all within easy reach.

Available immediately and offered on a furnished basis, this charming apartment is ideal for professional tenants seeking spacious accommodation in a highly convenient location. 

  Tenant Fee Act 1019. Under latest legislation, permitted tenant payments include:

- Rent
- Utility bills
- Holding deposit equivalent of 1 weeks rent
- Changes to an AST during tenancy
- Company let fees still apply
